requirements.requirement: Serve working HTTPS on node1 port 8443.
requirements.summary: HTTPS health requests returned “node1 HTTPS OK,” the process listened on port 8443, and the presented certificate contained node1 and 10.100.123.10 SANs. Service and listener recovery were also demonstrated after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Automatically renew the certificate before expiration.
requirements.summary: An active, enabled, persistent daily timer invokes a successful renewal service. The renewal policy issues 30-day certificates and checks for renewal when fewer than seven days remain; both non-renewal and forced-renewal paths completed successfully.

requirements.requirement: Pick up each newly activated certificate while continuing to answer requests.
requirements.summary: During a forced rotation, the peer certificate serial changed from C3A16CD7860FFDEC to D16876AB9C70EEEF without changing service PID 2942. Concurrent traffic completed 120 of 120 successful requests with no failures.

requirements.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic remained unchanged through implementation and reboot. The resulting service ran successfully using the platform's Python 3.5.2, OpenSSL 1.0.2g, and systemd 229.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. HTTPS service, automatic pre-expiry renewal policy, live certificate pickup under uninterrupted traffic, legacy-platform compatibility, and OS/kernel preservation were directly demonstrated. The provider-wide restart protocol was complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged reboot, changed boot identity, and recovered service, certificate data, timer, listener, and HTTPS response were captured and independently corroborated by lifecycle boot identities.
limitations: The scheduled timer was not observed reaching the seven-day renewal threshold naturally; automatic threshold behavior is supported by the inspected policy, active timer, successful renewal unit, and forced end-to-end rotation test.

The fixed after-executor listening-socket inventory was blank and therefore did not independently corroborate port 8443, although repeated executor commands directly showed the listener and successful HTTPS requests before and after reboot.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Created directories, scripts, certificates, and systemd units directly supported the task. Initial Python-import and certificate-validation defects were corrected as part of implementation, with no failed unit left behind. Temporary traffic-test files were bounded evidence artifacts and were absent after reboot. Final lifecycle observations showed healthy package state and no failed services; the added systemd-private temporary directory belongs to the required HTTPS service.
